worker.outcomeSummary: Rewrote migrateConfig in src/config.ts so the legacy document is read on its own terms before anything is renamed or defaulted: every key must be a recognized legacy spelling (normalized for case/separators), no setting may be supplied twice under two spellings, and each value the document actually carries is validated (non-empty string name/endpoint; integer retries >= 0; integer timeout > 0) instead of being silently replaced by a v2 default. Defaults now apply only to omitted optional settings, and the change is committed in the worktree.
